home.subtitle: We make playful games with comic visuals and chaotic creativity. Welcome to the headquarters of Los Super Ninis!

feature_1.title: Playful Games
feature_1.desc: Mechanics that put a smile on your face. We prioritize fun over physics!

feature_2.title: Comic Visuals
feature_2.desc: A unique aesthetic inspired by the golden age of comics and pop culture.

feature_3.title: Pure Creativity
feature_3.desc: Hand-crafted assets, original stories, and zero corporate boredom.

team.title: WHO ARE WE?
team.desc_1: Los Super Ninis started as a late-night joke and turned into a dedicated indie studio. We believe in games that don't take themselves too seriously but are seriously fun to play.
team.desc_2: Our mission? To save the world from boredom, one pixel at a time.
